description: Don't miss the Version 1.0 Launch Trailer for Dungeon Clawler, a strategy roguelike deckbuilder developed by Stray Fawn Studio. Sudden Strike 5 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Stonemachia, a third-person action souls-like game developed by Crossfall Games. Players will embody Zefiro, a pawn with the ability to change into different chess pieces. Explore the lands of Medhelan, unlock new abilities, and return to Heaven across the Italian art and folklore-inspired experience. Stonemachia is launching on May 26 for PC (Steam).

title: Afloat: A Relaxing Adventure - Official Launch Trailer

description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Bandit Trap, a chaotic multiplayer game developed by Picomy. Players will assemble their crews to defend or attack the house in search of loot. Make the right gear selections, evade traps, and claim treasures for victory. Bandit Trap is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!, a 3D anime arcade driving platformer developed by Strange Scaffold. Complete objectives across the real and fantasy world, run over unsuspecting people, and explore the small town of Wenvale, USA. Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?! is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).

description: Take a look at the Playtest Trailer for Pulse Drive, an arcade rhythmic racer developed by Nemi. Players will race through dreamlike courses across 50 tracks. Tap to the beat to gain speed, rise the leaderboards, and win medals. Pulse Drive is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Zuko Techniques Overview Trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game (working title), an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the hit Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. 
Players can get an overview of the fierce warrior from the Fire Nation with Zuko stepping into battle. Get an in-depth look at the latest technique video, going over the most honorable fighting technique of all time: Divekicks! Fight as Zuko in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, launching on July 2 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.

author: GameTrailers
description: Updates to the KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy series will be coming to the sci-fi strategy games. In collaboration with a team led by KKND  series modder Andre ‘IceReaper’ Mohren, Krush Kill 'N Destroy Xtreme (1997) and Krush Kill 'N Destroy 2: Krossfire (1998) will add modern online PvP multiplayer to Steam and GOG. Watch the latest KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy series trailer to see what to expect with this update, which also brings new patches that will introduce additional display resolutions, game balance improvements, improved support for mods, additional playable languages, and fixes to known issues with the previous releases. The KKND series updates will be available in June 2026 on PC via Steam and GOG.
title: KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy - Official Series Major Update Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Leafy Corner, a plant shop management simulation game developed by Fireline Games. Players will complete orders, nurture vibrant plants, and design the shop as they see fit. Leafy Corner is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Leafy Corner - Official Demo Launch Trailer

description: Check out the trailer for Antarctic Grave, an upcoming first-person survival horror game set in an isolated Antarctic research station. Players must explore the frozen facility, gather tools and weapons, maintain the generator, and outsmart hostile mutants to survive the extreme conditions. Antarctic Grave will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Antarctic Grave - Official Trailer

description: Don't miss the Rex Splode Towel Skin Trailer for Invincible VS, the hit 3v3 tag fighting game developed by Quarter Up. Players will be able to fight as Rex Splode in a whole new way with the Towel Skin, offering a bit of a spicy look into Rex Splode as the hero he is. The Towel Skin for Rex Splode is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Invincible VS - Official Rex Splode Towel Skin Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Sea Walker Saga, a steampunk strategy game developed by Antelus Games. Players will explore a vast open world, assemble battle islands, and take on fierce pirates to survive. Sea Walker Saga is launching into Early Access on May 14 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Sea Walker Saga - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Raccoons to Riches is a roguelike deck builder all about running a fantasy item shop as an industrious raccoon. Manage your shop and customers over the course of one in-game month to rake in huge profits. Time to Strike it Rich! Watch the Raccoons to Riches trailer to see gameplay and more. Raccoons to Riches will be available on PC on July 20, 2026.
title: Raccoons to Riches - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at gameplay from Vitta Lucis in this trailer for the upcoming action hack-and-slash game. Vitta Lucis is a mercenary from a private church guild, possessing demonic powers. Assemble a squad of Church Demons and embark on a dark fantasy action adventure. Faith in God was partly a mistake - curses, demons, and other evil spirits do exist.
title: Vitta Lucis - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at gameplay from HarpoonArena in this trailer for the upcoming fast-paced top-down team shooter game. In HarpoonArena, the arena is split in half, limiting direct hero contact. Use a harpoon to pull enemies to your side and finish them with teammates! Accuracy and cold calculation will lead you to victory. Just avoid other harpoons flying from all directions. HarpoonArena will be available on PC in 2026.
title: HarpoonArena - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Death Howl to see what to expect with the Rebirth Update, which brings the Rebirth Mode, Custom Mode, enemy tweaks, 7 new totems, card buffs, and more to the soulslike open-world deck-builder game. In the Rebirth Update, the journey through the Spirit World gets even tougher, introducing empowered enemies, reworked cards, and revamped battles alongside the new Rebirth Mode. Death Howl is available now on PC (Steam, GOG, Windows), Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch. The free Rebirth update is out now.

Rebirth Mode, which unlocks after completing the initial playthrough, is all about survival of the fittest. Enemies come equipped with new abilities and increased health, while Realmless cards are transformed with new names, effects, and visuals. As Ro continues her journey through a more dangerous-than-ever Spirit World, still grappling with the loss of her son, she’ll also take on a new look, donning a blue robe.

Custom Mode raise
title: Death Howl - Official Rebirth Mode Trailer

description:
Get a deep dive into the story, world, and gameplay of Capy Castaway in this trailer for the upcoming cozy exploration adventure game, where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home.Capy Castaway will be available on Steam.

#CapyCastaway #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take another look at gameplay and more from Littlelands in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game set in a charming world filled with adorable characters and vibrant, claymation-like landscapes, lush with vegetation. Experience the daily life of the Littlelands at your own pace, exploring all of its mysterious nooks and crannies as you get to know and help the region's quirky inhabitants. Grow berries, hunt for treasure, fish, or just sit on a wooden bench and watch the sunset. 

Littlelands will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch 2, and a demo is out now on Steam. The demo features custom character creation, six unique areas, multiple shops, twenty NPCs to interact with, a selection of tools to unlock, and seven enemy types for aspiring adventurers to whack.

#Littlelands #Gaming #IGN
title: Littlelands - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Vexlands trailer for this upcoming adventure game to see gameplay and more. Vexlands is a realm of surprises. Every newly opened space brings a surprise: loot, resources, dungeons, monsters and disasters! Build your village where you craft new equipment before you explore uncharted areas, and find relics that explain who came before and why these lands are cursed. Vexlands will be available on PC and consoles in summer 2026, and an expanded demo is out now.

#Vexlands #Gaming #IGN
title: Vexlands - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Magical Blush in this latest trailer for the upcoming spell-infused 2D action-adventure game. The new trailer showcases combat and more. Magical Blush is a fast-paced, top-down adventure that combines combo-driven spellcasting with metroidvania-style exploration. Chain dazzling elemental attacks, uncover secrets hidden behind clever traversal challenges, and carve your path through a colorful, multi-location journey. Magical Blush will be available on PC in summer 2026, and it is coming to Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S at a later date.

#MagicalBlush #Gaming #IGN
title: Magical Blush - Official Trailer

description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Prime Monster, a card-based strategy roguelike developed by Cavalier Game Studios. Players will take to the political landscape to compete for votes, endure campaign-ending scandals, and survive a parliament of monsters. Dive into a democratic dystopia in Prime Monster, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Prime Monster - Official Launch Trailer

description: Take a look at the Dig In announcement trailer for the upcoming World War 1 trench warfare colony sim, where you build an evolving trench network with layered defenses, manage soldiers under pressure while holding a fragile sector of the front in real-time tactical battles. Dig In will be available on PC. A demo for Dig In will be available during Steam Next Fest in June 2026.
title: Dig In - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Ash & Adam's Existential Treads, a city-building tower-defense strategy game developed by Ash & Adam's Games. Players will take on waves of enemies across a post-post-apocalyptic world to nurture a settlement and restore nature to its natural order. Scavenge for resources, rescue settlers, and explore procedurally generated levels. Ash & Adam's Existential Treads is available now for PC (Steam and Itch.io).
